relationships.subject: swimming exercise
relationships.evidence_quote: Swimming decreased mechanical allodynia on postoperative days 21–42 and decreased cold allodynia on postoperative days 14–42 in SNI mice

key_findings: Swimming exercise reduces FTO in injured DRG of SNI mice, raising m6A methylation and expression of miR-183, which lowers Cacna2d2 and BDNF/TrkB and relieves allodynia.
FTO knockdown mimics and limits further benefit of swimming; miR-183 knockout causes allodynia and raises Cacna2d2 and BDNF/TrkB without altering FTO.
